site.title: SwarmNote
site.tagline: Your notes, swarming across your own devices
site.description: A local-first, peer-to-peer note-taking app. No accounts, no servers, no subscriptions — your notes live as Markdown files on your devices, syncing directly between them via libp2p.

hero.h1: Your notes, swarming across your own devices
hero.subtitle: Local-first · P2P sync · CRDT auto-merge · One Rust core for desktop and mobile
hero.subtitleShort: Notes that flow like nectar in your swarm
hero.microcopy: Open source · No accounts · No servers

metaphor.lede: Think of your devices as a swarm of bees: each device is a bee, the workspace is the hive, and notes flow like nectar between them.

items.title: Devices = bees
items.desc: Your laptop, phone, and desktop are members of the swarm

items.title: Notes = nectar
items.desc: Flowing peer-to-peer, never through a central server

items.title: Local-first
items.desc: Notes are plain .md files. Uninstall the app — your notes stay.

items.title: P2P sync
items.desc: libp2p connects devices directly. No server. No subscription.

items.title: CRDT auto-merge
items.desc: Powered by Yjs. Edit offline, no conflicts.

coreShared.h1: One Rust core, desktop and mobile
coreShared.lede: Tauri desktop and Expo mobile share the same swarmnote-core Rust crate — same business logic, same CRDT state, same P2P stack.
coreShared.footnote: @swarmnote/editor git submodule is imported on both sides — CodeMirror 6 editing experience is identical

pairing.lede: Generate a 6-digit code on one device, type it on another. Works across networks. No cloud relay.
steps: Type the code on the new device
The swarm grows; notes sync automatically
pairing.sidenote: Devices on the same Wi-Fi are auto-discovered via mDNS (in development)

folder.lede: A workspace is just a local folder. Open .md files in VS Code, Obsidian, or nvim. SwarmNote watches and merges your edits back into Yjs — no history loss, no conflicts.
folder.sidenote: Drop the workspace into Dropbox, OneDrive, or Git for additional backup

compare.lede: Only SwarmNote ships local Markdown + built-in P2P + character-level CRDT merge + fully open source (MIT)

ecosystem.lede: All projects share the swarm-p2p-core network layer

footer.brand: Built with Tauri · libp2p · CodeMirror 6 · Yjs
footer.noTracking: This website collects no user data · No tracking · No telemetry
